tips.text: Run Bifrost Echo solo, take the derelict every time, then finish the mission.
Fly a starter Railjack here; Venus Proxima enemies are low level and public squads often bring weak ships.
Open relics or roll Void Storm rewards in the same run; Void Storms do not change the derelict odds.
Expect many runs with nothing; Railjack caches have no bad-luck protection, though this derelict is one of the easier ones.
